decisions.reason: As the flagship shown on the home page and tied to the firm's cloud messaging direction, it meets aspirations, and management has strong commitment to carry it while results develop.
Its own product page signals investment, and it supports the electronic document workflow strategy, so no shortfall triggers problemistic search.
It extends the established fax and email base at low incremental cost, and existing slack lets the firm carry it, although fax is a declining channel.
It is a low-cost feature close to the core fax offer that adds to service quality, so dropping it would release few resources.
Sandbox threat protection matches strong demand for email security in regulated sectors and fits the firm's positioning on security.
Multi-engine scanning is a modest extension of the security portfolio with low maintenance burden, so there is little pressure to drop it.
